info.title: PlaiiinLightOS Lamp API
info.description: HTTP API of a PlaiiinLight lamp (ESP32 firmware). Discover lamps on the LAN via mDNS service `_plaiiinlight._tcp` (TXT: id, node, fw, api, lamp, paired); the base URL is `http://<lamp>.local`. Auth: when the lamp is *paired* every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; roles are user < creator < admin and `GET /api/whoami` tells you yours. An *unpaired* lamp needs no auth at all. Errors are JSON `{status:"error",message}` with 400 (bad body), 401 (missing/invalid key), 403 (role too low), 404 (not found / not applicable to this lamp form), 409 (conflicts with current state). The contract is additive within a major version.

host.description: The lamp's mDNS host name (its node name).

get.description: Static facts about this lamp: identity, form/model, LED geometry and versions. Call first to learn ledCount and lampForm.
On/off, base colour, effective mode, brightness, loaded effect name and rendered FPS.
Heap, uptime, last reset reason, FPS and whether the lamp is in brown-out safe boot (panel held off until POST /api/power).
Running firmware version, build date/time, partition, IDF version, form and chip target.
SPIFFS usage for uploaded scripts (bytes) and file count.
The OpenAPI description of this lamp's API; may be served with Content-Encoding: gzip.

Natural-language description of this lamp's physical form and pixel layout, meant to be pasted into an LLM prompt that writes a `shade()` script for it. `effective` is the text to use; `hasOverride`/`override` show a user customisation. Wormhole lamps add `mode` and `byMode`.
Role the request's bearer key grants (none/user/creator/admin) and whether the lamp is paired.
Whether the lamp requires auth. No auth needed.

post.description: Unpaired: empty body mints the first admin token (bootstrap). Paired: send the current admin bearer to rotate it. Store the returned token.

delete.description: Removes auth entirely so any LAN client may call the API. Role: admin.

get.description: All issued keys including secrets, roles, labels and revoked flags. Role: admin.

post.description: Issue a user or creator key, e.g. one per agent; the secret is only returned here. Role: admin.

delete.description: Drops the key entirely. Role: admin.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Key id from GET /api/keys or POST /api/keys.

post.description: Marks the key revoked but keeps it listed. Role: admin.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Key id from GET /api/keys or POST /api/keys.

post.description: Turns the panel on or off with the configured fade; also clears a brown-out safe boot. Role: user.

get.description: Current master brightness 0-255. Role: user.

post.description: Master brightness 0-255, persisted; capped by maxBrightness. Role: user.

Paint the lamp. Use `color` to fill every LED with one colour (simplest), or `colors` with exactly one [r,g,b] per logical LED (ledCount from GET /api). In js/frame mode the framebuffer is not touched (the effect owns it) but the base colour the running script tints from is updated. Role: user.

oneOf.description: Fill: one colour for the whole lamp.
Per-pixel: one entry per logical LED, in index order.

get.description: The colour JS effects blend onto; set it via POST /api/color. Role: user.
`mode` is the effective mode (stream while a WebSocket client streams), `persistent` the stored one, `current` the loaded effect. Role: user.

post.description: `api` = solid colour from POST /api/color, `js` = run the current effect, `frame` = show the stored frame, `stream` = WebSocket frames. Prefer POST /api/play to start an effect (it switches to js for you). Role: user.

get.description: Brightness ceiling and current cap (mA, 0 = off). Role: user.

post.description: Any subset; maxCurrentMa scales brightness so estimated draw (20 mA/channel at 255) never exceeds it. Use to make an under-powered lamp safe. Role: admin.

get.description: Physical vs logical pixel grid and the grouping between them. Role: user.

post.description: Combine W×H physical LEDs into one logical pixel (persisted). Role: admin.

get.description: Power-on / power-off fade durations in ms. Role: user.

post.description: Any subset; 0 = instant. Role: admin.

get.description: Every playable effect: `effects` carries name, description, tags and whether it is a built-in (hardcoded) or an uploaded script; `scripts` is the same set as bare names (legacy). Pick by description/tags, then POST /api/play. Role: user.
JS source of an uploaded script (404 for hardcoded effects). Role: user.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Effect/script name as listed by GET /api/js.

put.description: Create/replace an effect from JS source implementing `function shade(x, y, idx, frame, base, params)` (see /api/form-prompt and shade-runtime.js). Validated and run once before it is stored; a `// @description` and `// @tags a,b` header comment is surfaced by GET /api/js. Name must not collide with a hardcoded effect. Role: creator.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Effect/script name as listed by GET /api/js.

delete.description: Removes an uploaded script. Role: creator.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Effect/script name as listed by GET /api/js.

get.description: Tunable parameters of an effect with range, default, live value and description. Role: user.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Effect/script name as listed by GET /api/js.

put.description: Partial update `{paramName: value, …}`; applies live and persists. Role: user.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Effect/script name as listed by GET /api/js.

post.description: Pre-flight JS source through the same check PUT /api/js/{name} uses, without storing it. 400 carries the reason. Role: creator.
Compile JS source to PLBC bytecode and return it (binary); 400 with the compiler message on failure. Role: creator.
Load and run an effect by name (switches to js mode). `fps` optional, defaults per effect. Role: user.
Stops playback. Role: user.
Advance alphabetically and play. Role: user.
Step back alphabetically and play. Role: user.

get.description: `current` is the persisted selection (survives reboot), `playing` what runs right now (null in api mode). Role: user.
Raw RGB bytes (logicalW×logicalH×3) with X-Frame-W/H headers; 404 if none stored. Role: user.

post.description: Raw RGB body exactly logicalW×logicalH×3 bytes (GET /api/grid); stored, displayed and mode set to frame. For a single colour use POST /api/color instead. Role: creator.

get.description: Saved frames with their geometry. Role: user.

post.description: Snapshot the stored frame into a new image slot; 409 when the store is full. Role: creator.

get.description: Raw RGB bytes with X-Frame-W/H headers. Role: user.

delete.description: Removes a saved image. Role: creator.

post.description: Copy a saved image to the frame store, display it and persist frame mode. Role: user.

get.description: Whether this lamp is in an ESP-NOW swarm (effects follow the leader) and its channel. Role: user.
Link and protocol counters for swarm traffic. Role: user.
Broker settings and connection state. Role: admin.

post.description: Enable/disable and set broker port (host via /config page). Role: admin.

get.description: Returns every saved scene with its document, so a client or agent can pick one by content. Role: user.
The scene document. Role: user.

put.description: Store an explicit scene document under this name (overwrites). Up to 32 scenes. Role: creator.

post.summary: Capture current state as a scene
post.description: Snapshots the lamp's CURRENT on/mode/script+params (or image)/color/brightness under this name and returns the document — the natural way to make a scene: set the lamp up, then save it. Role: creator.

Applies the scene in the correct order (content, params, brightness, power, then colour) using the lamp's normal fades; persists, and mirrors to MQTT/swarm like manual control. Prefer this over issuing the individual calls yourself. Role: user.

bearerAuth.description: Key from POST /api/pair (admin) or POST /api/keys (user/creator). Only required when GET /api/pair reports paired=true.

Error.description: Error (400 bad body, 401 no/invalid key, 403 role too low, 404 not found or not applicable to this form, 409 conflicts with current state, 5xx firmware error).

deviceId.description: Stable factory id (MAC); not a secret, never an auth token.

ledCount.description: Logical LED count — the length POST /api/color `colors` must have.

lampForm.description: tower, cube, display, strip, rocket or wormhole.

description.description: What the effect looks like; empty if the script has no header comment.

tags.description: Mood/style/motion tags, e.g. calm, cozy, fire, fast.

source.description: hardcoded = compiled into firmware (no source), script = uploaded JS.

Scene.description: A saved lamp state. Every field is optional; an absent field means 'leave as is'. script implies js mode, image implies frame mode; mode is used only when neither is given (e.g. api + color for a solid scene).

script.description: Effect to play (hardcoded or stored script name).

params.description: Effect parameter values by name (partial OK).

image.description: Saved image name (img-NNN) to show in frame mode.
